[Act: negotiable-instruments
 Chapter: Of Acceptance and Payment for Honour and Reference in Case of Need
 Section: 108::Acceptance for honour.
]


When a bill of exchange has been noted or protested for non-acceptance or for better security, any person not being a party already liable thereon may, with the consent of the holder, by writing on the bill, accept the same for the honour of any party thereto. 1***
